summary: 38-year-old woman with attacks of pounding headache, sweating and palpitations; BP 220/120 during an attack.

inputs.hpi: For six months, attacks lasting 20 minutes of pounding headache, drenching sweating and palpitations with a feeling of doom. BP measured at 220/120 during an attack. Normal between attacks.

mustInclude.note: The triad of episodic headache, sweating and palpitations with hypertension calls for plasma metanephrines (Endocrine Society 2014).

guideline.name: Pheochromocytoma and paraganglioma: an Endocrine Society clinical practice guideline
guideline.citation: Lenders JWM et al. J Clin Endocrinol Metab 2014;99:1915-1942

rationale: The zebra check should offer phaeochromocytoma for the classic paroxysmal triad.
